name: rest of season projected points added positive and net alongside the week variant
description: The two rest-of-season variants live as two COLUMNS on one period table, so they must resolve to ONE join carrying both, while the week variant stays on its own table under its own week predicate. This is the shape that replaced the period sentinels: before the split all three were rows in league_format_player_projection_values under week '5', 'ros' and 'ros_net', the table alias had to carry the period to keep them apart, and without that they collapsed into one join group whose single week predicate made two of the three render the third's value under their own header. Two different tables cannot share a join group, so that whole class is gone rather than guarded. This fixture pins that the period columns ignore the week param rather than following it. Params are explicit so nothing here is clock-derived.
